name: Valkey
description: Valkey is an open-source high-performance key/value datastore for caching, queues and application data.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent Valkey data. Must be writable by UID/GID 500:500.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Password required by clients connecting to Valkey. A strong password is recommended.

variables.name: Maximum Memory
variables.description: Maximum amount of memory Valkey may use. Adjust this value for the workload and available RAM.

variables.name: Memory Policy
variables.description: Eviction policy. Common values include noeviction and allkeys-lru.

variables.name: Append Only
variables.description: Enable or disable append-only persistence: yes or no.
